leadText:
For the Gym Leader whose name is "Melissa" in Japanese, see Fantina.
----
 
Melissa (Japanese: ヨシキ Yoshiki, a male in the Japanese version) is a character of the day who appeared in The Fourth Round Rumble.

Melissa d during the fourth round of the Indigo Plateau Conference. Melissa was shown to be a quite powerful . As only one Pokémon remained in each Trainer's team, Melissa's defeated Gary's , sending the Pallet Town resident home. Melissa was not seen afterwards.

Melissa is male in the Japanese version, and female in the English version.

Melissa (Japanese: ヨシキ Yoshiki, a male in the Japanese version) is a character of the day who appeared in The Fourth Round Rumble.

Melissa d during the fourth round of the Indigo Plateau Conference. Melissa was shown to be a quite powerful . As only one Pokémon remained in each Trainer's team, Melissa's defeated Gary's , sending the Pallet Town resident home. Melissa was not seen afterwards.

Melissa is male in the Japanese version, and female in the English version.

==Pokémon==
 
 

Melissa also has at least two other Pokémon, having faced Gary in a 3-on-3 battle.

==Achievements==
===Pokémon League===
Melissa has competed in the following Pokémon League Conferences:
Indigo Plateau Conference - Top 16 or higher (The Fourth Round Rumble)
